questions.q:
The nth term of a sequence is n² − 3n.
(a) Write down the first three terms. [1]
(b) Find the 10th term. [1]
questions.tip: Substitute carefully: n² − 3n with n = 2 is 4 − 6 = −2.

questions.q:
The points (x, y) have integer coordinates and satisfy all three inequalities
x ≥ 1     y > x     x + y ≤ 6
(a) List all the points (x, y). [3]
(b) Find the greatest value of 2x + y for these points. [1]
ms: (a) B1: no extra points (e.g. not (1, 1), (2, 2) or (3, 3))
questions.tip: Strict inequalities (<, >) exclude the boundary; ≤ and ≥ include it.

questions.q:
y is directly proportional to (x + 1)². When x = 2, y = 36.
(a) Find a formula for y in terms of x. [2]
(b) Find the positive value of x when y = 100. [2]
questions.tip: Write the proportion with k first, then find k: that is the method mark.

questions.q:
Here are the first five terms of three sequences.
Sequence A: 7, 11, 15, 19, 23, …
Sequence B: 3, 9, 27, 81, 243, …
Sequence C: 3, 8, 15, 24, 35, …
(a) Find the nth term of sequence A. [2]
(b) Find the nth term of sequence B. [1]
(c) Find the nth term of sequence C. [2]
(d) Which term of sequence C is equal to 255? [2]
ms: (c) M1: second difference 2 seen, or n² + bn + c with one correct coefficient
(d) M1: n² + 2n = 255 FT their (c), or n² + 2n − 255 = 0 and attempt to solve
questions.model:
(a) Difference 4: 4n + 3 (because 4 × 1 + 3 = 7).
(b) Powers of 3: 3ⁿ.
(c) Differences 5, 7, 9, 11; second difference 2, so the sequence starts n².
Subtract n²: 3 − 1 = 2, 8 − 4 = 4, 15 − 9 = 6, … which is 2n.
nth term = n² + 2n.
(d) n² + 2n = 255 → n² + 2n − 255 = 0 → (n + 17)(n − 15) = 0 → n = 15.
It is the 15th term.
questions.tip: Halve the second difference to get the coefficient of n².

questions.q:
The intensity, I, of light from a lamp is inversely proportional to the square of the distance, d, from the lamp.
(a) I = 50 when d = 4. Find d when I = 8. [3]
(b) The distance d is increased by 25%. Find the percentage decrease in I. [2]
questions.model:
(a) I = k/d². 50 = k/16, so k = 800.
8 = 800/d² → d² = 100 → d = 10.
(b) New d = 1.25d, so new I = k/(1.25d)² = I/1.5625 = 0.64I.
I is multiplied by 0.64, so it decreases by 36%.
questions.tip: For (b), you do not need a value of k: think about what happens to I when d is multiplied by 1.25.
